scope.operation: Local file/header/schema and existing metadata inspection only

component_join.identity: component_id = digest([owner, canonical_key]), independent of capture/date. Join identical stored IDs; do not substitute session_id.
component_join.caveat: Canonical key includes both IPs and both ports, so cross-year address/ephemeral-port drift causes genuine key mismatch; absence does not imply anomaly.

service_join.owner_direction_definition: Owner-relative side from recorded Ethernet src/dst MAC; do not infer from port size/private IP/q14[13].
service_join.available: C2b joined-selected rows already contain validated owner_ip/port, remote_ip/port, canonical_key and owner-relative direction; all saved attacks were covered in the prior audit.
service_join.gaps: Prepared UNSW query rows omit canonical_key and endpoint fields. Historical C1 REF metadata has unordered canonical_key but no owner_ip, remote_ip or owner-relative direction. Exact service intersection needs a UID/component map with validated owner-side identity for all residual queries AND reference services; C2b is a selected old-B2 subset, not automatically the complete C1/C3 history union.
service_join.broad_caveat: Prior 43487/60% attack intersection was broad, owner+remote_port+protocol, and with the old B2 observation services. It is a risk precedent, not a recomputation for historical C1/C3/C4.

versions.C1: D2 retrieved/history/*/encoded: three historical device banks plus frozen dense observation banks; D2 A/B decisions are C1.
versions.C2: Same C1 support with SYN-no-ACK effective support forced to zero; use output/ab DECISIONS and output/dev DECISIONS.
versions.C3: C2 B decisions unchanged; A adds 278 Heim admitted reference rows. A C3 support differs from C2.
versions.C4: Future output is a new bank/support version; not inspected here. Reuse C3 arrays only for pre-C4 description, not as a C4 residual estimate.

DA.conservative_effort: 5–15 minutes for complete hash/UID joins, component counts and existing service-map coverage audit; if raw owner-endpoint recovery is needed, it is a separate bounded local header audit, not promised by this estimate.

target_fixed_support_replay.basis: C3 A/B DECISIONS include uid/raw_logits(N,3)/support/guard/base/corrected. Load cuts/scales and q14 separately; preserve strict > cut and original ordered ensemble arithmetic.
required_conditions: Freeze reference bank/support version, heads, geometry, normalizer, scales, cuts and SYN guard.
Do not replace three-head raw_logits with saved corrected logits; do not apply a correction twice.
For guarded rows use RAW/effective support zero; use exact primary population and both weighted/unweighted metrics.
Support=1 is an optimistic arithmetic bound, not the actual saved-support replay.
Increasing lambda cannot repair zero-support or guarded normal queries; a fixed-support replay cannot predict a new reference bank or changed geometry/support rule.
All A/B-derived comparisons remain consumed development diagnostics; no lambda is selected in this review.
target_fixed_support_replay.conservative_effort: 3–10 minutes for existing-array joins, input hashing, descriptive fixed-support arithmetic and all-group report generation; not a measured runtime benchmark.

source_CAL.correction: The 20261025 NEEDS_SOURCE_ENCODING/104-point status was superseded by 179602 SOURCE_CAL_COMPLETE with 4728 references.
source_CAL.why: 179602 src/source_cal.py constructs normal own support and attack donor matrix in memory, then stores only PREPARATION/EPSILON/parity JSON summaries. No per-row support NPZ is present in the saved source_cal directory.
source_CAL.full_CAL_original_arrays: source_actual_trace.npz has 148819 original_logits(N,3), original_decisions(N,4), uid and D1 delta/raw_shift; it does not have V3 support. CAL.npz indexes full LEARN_q and metadata.
source_CAL.source_180228_limitation: G0/G1 CAL SCORES.npz have raw(N,4) plus Q/N/C_support(N,6) from learned competition branches and different source BASE fold endpoints. They are not fixed geometric V3 own support and cannot be substituted for it.
source_CAL.historical_additions_scope: C1/C3 historical additions affect target A/B device+partition+protocol banks. They do not add matching LEARN source devices, so adding them does not make source CAL simulate target historical coverage risk.
source_CAL.next_requirement: A same-bank V3 source-CAL lambda replay requires the absent saved per-row own/donor support, or a separately authorized bounded new distance replay over existing full CAL features and the saved 4728 bank. No new model encoding is inherently needed; the 20261025 encoding plan alone must not be treated as current blocker.

ACK33.interpretation: C3 versus C2 ensemble newly withdrawn Heim TCP queries; saved flags16/ACK-only. Do not relabel them normal or claim pure ACK proves malicious semantics. Use uid to join the saved full A metadata/C2b endpoint map and C3 DECISIONS.
